_meta.framework: Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills — English Language Arts and Reading
_meta.reviewNote: Plain-language paraphrases for teacher display, checked 2026-09-17 against the codified 19 TAC text (Cornell LII reproduction). Grade 5 = §110.7; middle school = §110.22 (6), §110.23 (7), §110.24 (8). The (b)(2)/(b)(3) vocabulary strand: 'the student uses newly acquired vocabulary expressively.' CAVEAT: grades 6 and 7 rest on the single Cornell LII reproduction; grade 8 (b)(2)(C) was cross-verified against Texas Gateway. Note: the TEKS text itself does not use the word 'cognates' — cognate awareness is an ELPS/cross-linguistic strategy layered onto the context and roots expectations.

standards.subject: elar
standards.summary: Use context within and beyond a sentence to determine the relevant meaning of unfamiliar or multiple-meaning words.

standards.subject: elar
standards.summary: Identify the meaning of and use words with affixes (such as trans-, super-, -ive, -logy) and roots (such as geo, photo).

standards.summary: Use print or digital resources to determine the meaning, syllabication, pronunciation, and word origin of words.

standards.summary: Give an organized presentation with eye contact, appropriate rate, volume, enunciation, natural gestures, and conventions of language.
